Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: EMEA / APAC stage certification & closure checklist

Hi all,

We're entering the final certification window for the EMEA & APAC rollups next week. Finance will cut the preliminary numbers on Monday 07/19 at 09:00 UTC and needs staged opportunities to be accurate by EOD Sunday (07/18) for any offline adjustments.

Ask: please do a last-mile pass on your owned opportunities in the roster and confirm one of the three outcomes for each record: Commit / Commit - contingent (contracts/procurement) / No-go. Use the attached "Nimbus_Commit_Checklist_Q3.xlsx" and update the Owner column in the attached Stage_Owners_Roster.csv.

Quick rules:
- If procurement confirmation or signed SOW is outstanding, mark as "Commit - contingent" and add the expected close date + outstanding blocker in the notes column.
- Move any opportunity with >30% legal redline risk to No-go and flag for escalation.
- For any deals with custom pricing >15% off list, include approval owner in the comment (sales lead + CRO).

Marissa — please run the aggregation script after you get owner updates and paste the summary into the Drive doc (link below). Vanessa & Mina — target your top 8 deals for manual validation.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cForecasts
Attachments: Nimbus_Commit_Checklist_Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Stage_Owners_Roster.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, EMEA Sales Operations
